To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an NFC tag that dynamically switches between different antenna configurations to achieve high PDL, and reliable communication.
we have developed a low cost wireless power efficient NFC tag that can be used for a wide range of applications.
the NFC tag antenna can be dynamically switched to improve the PDL by 2.4X (from 2.4mW to 5.7mW), and the range and alignment sensitivity of the NFC communication can be significantly reduced.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of NFC tags with dynamic and robust wireless power delivery and communication.
improving the performance of the low cost NFC tag in terms of the range and alignment sensitivity and the run time power consumption.
the development of a new class of NFC tags that are able to achieve higher power delivery efficiency and robust communication performance in a low cost manner.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method can significantly improve the performance and usability of the NFC tag.
we have proposed a new low cost and robust method to improve the performance of a NFC tag by utilizing switchable receiver antennas.
the proposed antenna design is a low cost and effective solution for the NFC tag to dynamically adapt its antenna configuration and achieve high power efficiency and communication reliability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can use the same tag to perform different tasks by simply changing its run time antenna configuration.
we have designed and implemented a novel low cost NFC tag antenna that can dynamically adapt to varied alignment, range, and load impedance to ensure high power delivery efficiency.
our proposed design can improve the power efficiency of a passive tag by 2-5X compared with the conventional design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method provides the flexibility of dynamically switching antenna configurations in order to achieve higher power delivery and communication performance in a wide range of scenarios.
the proposed method can significantly reduce the power required by the reader for the NFC tag to operate reliably, and thus, it can enable the NFC tag to be more power efficient.
the power efficiency of the NFC tags can be significantly improved through switchable antennas and a low cost implementation.
